about: Render-versus-photo checks: the only record that a built feature was compared with the photos it cites. A 'cites' edge in refs/graph.json only says an author used a photo; a check says someone rendered the game from that photo's camera (scripts/shoot_views.cjs --task=<id> --as=after) and compared the two. Each check: task (data/build_queue.json id), feature (evidence-graph feature id), photo, render (committed after-render, usually docs/reviews/<task>/<photo>-after.png), before (optional), checked (date), by, result matches | differs | not-comparable, notes, and for differs a followUp task id that is not done. A photo used for a check needs a reviewed looksAt in data/reference_tags.json so the render faces the photo's subject. build_references.py --check fails when a done task has a photo without a check, unless the task is in legacyUnchecked; that list may only shrink.

checks.by: Claude (Dave's review of the live site)
checks.notes: Gate, open right leaf, planter and wall bench now come in the photo's order: about 1.7 m of planter behind the leaf, then the bench recess and tiled wall, then more planter. Before, the bench sat 0.1-1.1 m from the gate, directly behind the open leaf. Still different: the model shows lawn either side of a crossing tiled path where the photo shows a narrow crazy-paved forecourt with a tall hedge on the left.

checks.by: Claude (Dave's review of the live site)
checks.notes: Seat-height bench with a low plinth, recessed into the planter with planter either side, under a tall white wall with the tile panel; the open leaf is to its left (gate side) as in the photo. Tile motifs are schematic and the cypress and geraniums are Details planting.

Exact Apple Maps camera pose is unavailable, so no calibrated same-camera match is claimed. Independent aerial and oblique review confirms this individual projecting upper balcony roof and the bounded outline; the committed pair uses one shared estimated diagnostic camera. Plan edges ±1 m and 4.8/5.4 m eave/rear heights remain estimates. Hidden balcony/ground divisions are not modelled.
